etymology: a prolonged form of a primary verb, _*dokw*_ doko dok'-o (used only in an alternate in certain tenses cf the base of 1166) of the same meaning
avSummary: think 33, seem 13, suppose 7, seem good 3, please 2, misc 5
definition:
1) to be of opinion, think, suppose
 2) to seem, to be accounted, reputed
 3) it seems to me
    3a) I think, judge: thus in question
    3b) it seems good to, pleased me, I determined

 Sinonim   : Lihat Definisi 5837
